project_info.theme: Cold fashion portrait inside a subway carriage
project_info.color_palette: cool teal, black, muted gray, natural skin tones

main_subject.detail: A confident woman with natural skin texture and accurate facial features stands centered in a subway carriage. She wears a structured dark heavy-textured black jacket open over a muted gray knit sweater with a slightly loose fit and subtly distressed hem, dark modern pants, two thin silver chain necklaces, and a small cross pendant.

items: standing centered and leaning lightly against the closed metro door
both hands naturally inside dark-pant pockets
straight close-together balanced stance with head slightly tilted forward
intense, calm, confident, serious gaze directly at camera
metallic doors behind her, windows to both sides, and blurred passengers in the background

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: cinematic moody subway lighting with soft overhead lights
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: gentle shadows across the face and clothing, emphasizing texture and contrast

technical_specs.color_treatment: cool teal environment, natural realistic skin tones, professional cinematic grading, shallow depth of field

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic cinematic editorial fashion portrait of a confident woman standing inside a subway train carriage. She stands centered in frame, leaning back lightly against the closed metallic metro door, with both hands naturally inside the pockets of dark modern pants, a straight balanced stance, head slightly tilted forward, and an intense calm serious gaze directly at the camera. Preserve accurate facial features and natural skin texture. She wears a dark heavy-textured black jacket with a structured fit, worn open over a muted gray knit sweater with a slightly loose fit and subtly distressed hem, plus two thin silver chain necklaces and one small cross pendant resting naturally on the chest. Include cool-toned subway surfaces, windows on both sides, and blurred passengers in the background. Use soft overhead subway lights, gentle shadows, cool teal grading, natural skin tones, an eye-level 85mm portrait lens, and shallow depth of field with the subject sharp and the background softly blurred. No distortion, cartoon treatment, unrealistic lighting, watermark, or text overlay.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed, cartoon, illustration, unrealistic lighting

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: If a face reference is supplied, preserve its facial structure, proportions, features, and expression. Preserve the metro-door stance, black structured jacket, gray knit sweater, silver chains, subway carriage, teal grading, and eye-level editorial framing. Do not use celebrity/public-figure likeness.
